newsitem.title: USA: Burger King sees no evidence E. coli in its beef.
newsitem.headline: Burger King sees no evidence E. coli in its beef.

text.p: Burger King Corp said on Thursday that there is no evidence that any of the beef it received from its supplier contained the E. coli bacteria, despite a voluntary recall of patties by Hudson Foods Inc.

"While Burger King Corp, through its purchasing agent, Restaurant Services Inc, does purchase some of its beef patties from this supplier, there is absolutely no evidence to suggest that any of the beef we received from this supplier from the two production days in question contained the E. coli bacteria," the fastfood restaurant operator said in a statement.

Burger King also said it is cooperating with the U.S. Department of Agriculture on the recall and has instructed all its distribution centers and restaurants to set aside any beef from the two production days for pick up.
